name: starter
description: Site-wide starter templates for a new Leed site: the site template, the site-wide <head> tags in header-includes.hbs, a header and footer on Leed's menu builder, the brand theme with every --site-* and --docs-* token wired, the button system, and a home page. /leed:site-onboarding copies them; see its references/starter-templates.md.

files.note: The master wrapper: body offset by the measured --height-header, colors from --site-* tokens.

Site-wide <head> tags on every page, documentation pages included (site-patterns rule 14): the light and dark theme-color, with commented-out examples. Sites provisioned before the CLI shipped it lack the file, and it is then written as new.
One leed/menu/builder for the Header Menu, bar and drawer.
One leed/menu/builder for the Footer Menu.
The home page. Keeps the provisioned page's pageTypeId, pageId and publishedAt. Its site-hero__actions element is deleted when no section page is published yet.
Never copied: the lines in imports are added to the existing file, each once.
Brand tokens, Leed's --site-*, form, reading-progress and alert tokens, the @theme inline names, and the site font (--font-sans).
The header bar and drawer, and the footer columns.
The documentation theme color-theme-site. Written only when the company may set a custom theme name (Starter or above).
Measures the fixed header and opens the drawer.
Reuses the site header on documentation pages. Starter or above.
Reuses the site footer on documentation pages. Starter or above.

placeholders.###THEME_COLOR_LIGHT###: The light value of --brand-bg, exactly as it is written in the light :root block of tailwind/site/theme.css once the interview's colors are in, e.g. #fafafa. A meta cannot read a CSS variable, so header-includes.hbs repeats the value.
placeholders.###THEME_COLOR_DARK###: The dark value of --brand-bg, exactly as it is written in the prefers-color-scheme: dark block of tailwind/site/theme.css, e.g. #0b0b0f.
placeholders.###FONT_CLASS###: The site font's class, one of fonts below, e.g. font-inter. tailwind/site/theme.css sets --font-sans: var(--font-inter) from it, the one place the site font is configured, and site-template.hbs applies it with font-sans. The same value goes in documentationConfiguration.font.
placeholders.###HOME_PAGE_ID###: The pageId in the frontmatter of the site's current src/index.hbs.
placeholders.###HOME_PUBLISHED_AT###: The publishedAt in the frontmatter of the site's current src/index.hbs.
placeholders.###MODIFIED_AT###: The current time, as an ISO 8601 UTC timestamp.
placeholders.###ROOT_PAGE_TYPE_ID###: The pageTypeId in the frontmatter of the site's current src/index.hbs.
placeholders.###TAGLINE###: One sentence from the interview saying what the business does, HTML-escaped.
placeholders.###PRIMARY_PAGE_ID###: The pageId of the section page the hero button opens, only when that page is PUBLISHED: Leed replaces a pageid: link to a draft with a plain span, so the button would vanish. With no published section page, delete the whole site-hero__actions element instead.
placeholders.###PRIMARY_LABEL###: The hero button's text, e.g. the section page's title.
